_note: Per-ingredient equivalences (spec section 6: no conversion across dimensions without a verified equivalence for that ingredient). Applied when building the demo data, keeping the source text; 'per' is the target amount for one source unit. Demo values, to be confirmed by a curator. Scope 'shopping' applies only to shopping lists (you buy lemons, you cook with grams of juice).
